exceptions.name: SearchIndexCorruptedError
exceptions.trigger: Search index database or FTS5 table is damaged, corrupted, or unreadable.
exceptions.rationale: Corrupted derived views must trigger recovery rather than returning invalid search results.

exceptions.name: SearchProvenanceMissingError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to emit a search result without valid source_ref or source_watermark.

exceptions.name: SearchQuerySyntaxError
exceptions.trigger: Search query syntax is invalid or violates query parser grammar.

exceptions.name: SearchIndexRebuildOrderError
exceptions.trigger: Search rebuild invoked without access to authoritative CoreStore.
exceptions.rationale: Derived view rebuild requires authoritative sources.

exceptions.name: MemoryNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Requested memory item ID does not exist in store.

exceptions.name: MemoryStateTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted illegal transition on memory item lifecycle.

exceptions.name: MemorySourceRewriteForbiddenError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to mutate or overwrite raw record or artifact from memory operation.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 3: Memory is derived, never source truth.

exceptions.name: ContextPackBudgetExceededError
exceptions.trigger: Context pack construction exceeds explicit token budget constraint.

exceptions.name: NoEligibleRouteCandidateError
exceptions.trigger: No candidates meet capability, health, or policy constraints.
exceptions.rationale: Routing failure when candidate set is empty or disqualified.

exceptions.name: RoutingExecutionAttemptForbiddenError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to dispatch or execute work directly from router.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 7: Routing selects; it does not execute.

exceptions.name: RoutingPolicyViolationError
exceptions.trigger: Routing policy configuration is invalid or missing required weights.

exceptions.name: RoutingUnknownEvidencePolicyError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to bypass fail-safe UNKNOWN evidence policy.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 8: UNKNOWN stays unknown per policy.

exceptions.name: ApprovalNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Specified approval_id was not found in database.
exceptions.rationale: Non-existent approval token requested or consumed.

exceptions.name: ApprovalStateTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Illegal state transition attempted on approval request.

exceptions.name: ApprovalExpiredError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to approve or consume an expired approval token.

exceptions.name: ApprovalAlreadyConsumedError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to consume an approval token that has already been consumed.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 11: Approval tokens are strictly single-use.

exceptions.name: ApprovalEffectMismatchError
exceptions.trigger: Target effect payload does not match approved digest.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 11: Exact-effect binding prevents payload alteration.

exceptions.name: PlanBoundExceededError
exceptions.trigger: Execution exceeded plan bounds (max_depth, max_steps, max_fanout, timeout).

exceptions.name: AmbiguousExecutionReplayForbiddenError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to blindly retry non-idempotent step with MAY_HAVE_STARTED certainty.

exceptions.name: PlanDependencyCycleError
exceptions.trigger: Plan step dependency graph contains circular dependencies.

exceptions.name: PlanStepExecutionError
exceptions.trigger: Plan step execution permanently failed after exhausting retry attempts.

exceptions.name: PlanStateTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Illegal plan or step state machine transition attempted.

exceptions.name: A2AAgentNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Specified remote agent ID was not found in registered Agent Cards.

exceptions.name: A2AIdentityLeakForbiddenError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to use unmapped remote A2A identity as native PeerHub identity.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 5: A2A identities never become PeerHub identities implicitly.

exceptions.name: A2AExecutionTimeoutError
exceptions.trigger: Remote A2A task execution exceeded polling deadline.

exceptions.name: A2AStateTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Illegal state transition attempted on A2A task lifecycle.

exceptions.name: A2ACardValidationError
exceptions.trigger: Agent Card missing required endpoint or declared capabilities.
